title: Bridge theorem extension to complex-valued L2 functions

problemStatement.formal: theorem complex_bunyakovsky_schwarz (f g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : ‖∫ a, ⟪(f : α → ℂ) a, (g : α → ℂ) a⟫_ℂ ∂μ‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖g‖
problemStatement.plain: Extend the Bunyakovsky-Schwarz integral inequality from real to complex L2 via a bridge theorem.
whyMatters: Complex L2 Cauchy-Schwarz is fundamental to quantum mechanics and signal processing
The bridge theorem unifies abstract and integral forms
RCLike generalization covers both real and complex cases uniformly

proven: Bridge theorem: L2 inner product = integral of pointwise inner products
Complex Bunyakovsky-Schwarz in abstract, integral, and conjugation forms
Uniform RCLike formulation, real L2 recovery

currentState.focus: Gallery entry created for existing proof (0 sorries, 0 axioms).

knowledge.progressSummary: Complete formalization of complex L2 Cauchy-Schwarz with bridge theorem, multiple forms, equality characterization, and uniform RCLike generalization. Gallery entry created.
insights: L2.inner_def provides the bridge for any RCLike field
Complex inner product introduces conjugation: ⟪z,w⟫ = conj(z)·w

approaches.name: Bridge theorem + abstract CS transfer
approaches.description: Use L2.inner_def to bridge abstract inner product to integral, then transfer norm_inner_le_norm.
